name: Joshua Piesta
title: Penetration Tester & Security Enthusiast
tagline: I find the holes before attackers do. Former SOC analyst, now a penetration tester, always learning.
bio: I'm a penetration tester with a SOC analyst background. I perform manual security testing of web applications, APIs and mobile apps, chaining real exploits to demonstrate business impact rather than just listing scanner output.

Having worked on the defensive side, triaging alerts and hunting threats in enterprise SIEM tooling, I understand attacks from both ends. That shapes how I deliver: clear, prioritised reports, remediation guidance developers can act on, and close collaboration with engineering and security teams so findings get fixed, not just filed.
I'm committed to continuous learning and proactive defense. The certifications below are the evidence, and the list keeps growing as the threat landscape changes.
funFacts: I started on the blue team and switched to red. Now I know what both sides are thinking.
I read vulnerability write-ups the way other people read the news.
Favourite finding: the one the dev swore was impossible.
Yes, I have tried `sudo hire me` on my own site.

seo.description: Portfolio of Joshua Bobb Piesta, penetration tester with a SOC analyst background. Manual web, API and mobile application security testing, certifications and projects.
